c74object.name: stemversion
c74object.description: The `stemversion` object outputs a formatted string based on the current system time, useful for versioning exported stems or projects.

inlet.description: A bang message triggers the output of the current timestamp version string.

outlet.description: Outputs the timestamp string. The format depends on the @format and @brackets attributes.
If the log attribute is enabled, this outlet provides status messages.

method.name: log
method.description: Sets the `log` attribute in real time. When enabled (1), creates an additional outlet for status information.

method.name: format
method.description: Sets the `format` attribute in real time, determining the style of the output timestamp.

method.name: brackets
method.description: Sets the `brackets` attribute in real time, determining whether surrounding square brackets are included.

attribute.name: log
attribute.description: When enabled (1), creates an additional outlet for status information.

attribute.name: format
attribute.description: Sets the formatting style for the output timestamp. Options are 'default' (e.g., [2025-12-8-15-16-16]), 'sortable' (e.g., [2025-12-08-15-16-16]), and 'live' (e.g., [2025-12-08 151616]).

attribute.name: brackets
attribute.description: When enabled (1, default), wraps the output symbol in square brackets (e.g., [2025-12-08-15-16-16]). When disabled (0), surrounding brackets are omitted (e.g., 2025-12-08-15-16-16).
